summary: FASE 3.1 (visual refinement of A6-landscape booklet certificate PDF) — 11/11 backend tests PASS. Verified read-only regressions (POST /api/verify with fake number returns generic status='not_found'; GET /api/verify/qr/resolve?token=INVALIDTOKEN returns token_valid=false with no leakage; GET /api/settings/public returns whatsapp_number='6287812128884' + whatsapp_enabled=true; GET /api/legality returns unpublished/empty state). PDF E2E: created ONE TEST_ Blue Sapphire (Corundum) gemstone, issued a certificate (AZR-GEM-2026-000015), fetched GET /api/admin/certificates/{uuid}/pdf → HTTP 200, content-type application/pdf, exactly 2 pages, each mediabox 419.53 x 297.64 pt (148 x 105 mm) within ±1pt tolerance. Rendered page 2 via pdf2image@300dpi and decoded QR with pyzbar — payload matched regex '<base>/?qr=<token>#verification' and the embedded token equalled the qr_token returned at issuance. Public /api/verify with (cert_number, security_code) returned status='valid' with full gemstone details; /api/verify/qr with token returned status='valid'. Confirmed security_code and qr_token are NEVER present in either public verification response body. MANDATORY CLEANUP RAN: deleted the created certificate + gemstone + verification_token (no photo was uploaded so nothing in gemstone_photos), and restored counters:{name:'certificate', year:2026}.last_number back to 14. Final DB state asserted: certificates count == 0, gemstones count == 0 (including sweep of any TEST_ leftovers from prior iterations), counter last_number == 14 → next real certificate will be AZR-GEM-2026-000015. Note on run infra: pytest-xdist LoadScope split classes across workers and caused cleanup to race with the E2E tests on the first attempt; I re-ran with '-o addopts=' (sequential) and documented this requirement in the test module docstring.
critical_code_review_comments: services/certificate_pdf.py: build_certificate_pdf correctly enforces page size (PAGE_W=148mm, PAGE_H=105mm) and calls showPage() twice, so the 2-page A6-landscape contract is structurally guaranteed. QR is generated from cert['qr_url'] which is qr_url(token) = '<PUBLIC_BASE_URL>/?qr=<token>#verification' — matches the public verification prefill contract. Good.

api/certificates.py /api/admin/certificates/{uuid}/pdf swallows any SettingsRepository failure silently (bare except) when fetching WhatsApp. That's defensively fine here (PDF must not fail because of a settings issue), but consider logging the exception at warning level for observability instead of a silent pass.

services/issuance.py qr_url() falls back to a hardcoded preview host when PUBLIC_BASE_URL is unset. In production, PUBLIC_BASE_URL should be set explicitly; failing that, the QR still points to the current preview which is acceptable for now but a subtle deployment footgun. Consider raising at startup if PUBLIC_BASE_URL is missing in ENVIRONMENT=production.

Non-blocking design nit: build_certificate_pdf embeds the Times/Helvetica standard fonts due to unavailable brand TTFs. That's acknowledged in the module docstring; if brand fonts become available, wire them via pdfmetrics.registerFont to fully realize the intended luxury hierarchy.

Test-side: certificate_number regex not asserted server-side beyond the compound unique index; if that ever regresses, /api/verify anti-enumeration would still work but the atomic counter format wouldn't. Existing FASE 3 suite covers this — no change needed here.
seed_data_creation: Created 1 TEST_ gemstone + 1 certificate (AZR-GEM-2026-000015) purely for the PDF E2E, then FULLY REMOVED. Counter restored: counters.certificate:{year=2026}.last_number = 14 (verified). Next real number will be AZR-GEM-2026-000015. DB is go-live-clean.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Reusable suite: /app/backend/tests/test_fase3_1_pdf_visual.py (11 tests, ~6s). IMPORTANT: run with '-o addopts=' to disable xdist parallelism, otherwise the cleanup class races the E2E class across workers (LoadScope splits classes) and both fail spuriously. The suite itself atomically restores counter=14 and wipes any TEST_ leftovers on teardown. Deps used: pypdf (mediabox), pdf2image + pyzbar + libzbar0 + poppler-utils (QR decode) — all present. PUBLIC_BASE_URL is unset in backend/.env so QR URL uses the preview host fallback in services/issuance.py; that is expected. Prior FASE 3 regression suite /app/backend/tests/test_fase3_certificates.py (22 tests) also still applies for any deeper issuance/versioning retest.
rca of the issue: No production RCA — all functional requirements pass on first evaluation. The only transient failure was a test-runner artefact: /app/backend/pytest.ini enables pytest-xdist with LoadScope, which distributed TestPdfE2E on gw0 and TestZZZCleanupAndCounterRestore on gw1, so cleanup executed against an empty state before gw0 finished issuing, then the leftover cert AZR-GEM-2026-000015 blocked subsequent runs (E11000 on uq_certificate_number_version). Mitigated by (a) manually wiping the leftover once, (b) always running this module with '-o addopts=' so cleanup runs LAST, and (c) documenting the requirement in the module docstring.
